name: gui_material_from_blank
description: MT-1s, from Blank with the GUI only. File > New Project > Blank; Add Object > Cube and a Forward opaque material pass read by present put the grey box on screen (add_primitive_object's path: Add material pass... is the Graph's palette on Blank's graph root, GL-5c, and the pass's colour output is dragged onto present's + input). View > Materials; New material… lists the engine's surfaces (list_surfaces) and proposes a name and a file: OpenPBR's opaque one-sided variant, Create (create_material, registered live). The editor is made from the surface's declaration: base_color's swatch opens the colour dialog, red. The Inspector's Material combo binds the material to every primitive of the cube model (bind_material) and says the material is the model's. Without a restart the box's front is red. specular_roughness's spin reaches the engine; the dock's Undo takes it back, then the red: the document no longer sets base_color and the box is not red. VR-1: the dock's Surface box on OpenPBR's opaque double-sided variant sends the surface alone; the engine pairs the routing with it, so the dock's Alpha mode reads opaque and Double sided is ticked, without a restart (get_status.instance_id is the same), and the dock's Undo takes both back. MT-2s: the Inspector's Material rows apply to This object first; the MT-1s bind above is chosen on Every Cube. The generic materials list is not drawn. New material… material_2, made red, while every Cube stays on material (grey); a second Cube at x = 1.1 (N = 2, read again on the new revision). MT-2s-b: Every Cube on material_2 makes both red; MT-3s: a tag added to material_2 is registered again in place (Applied; rebuilt, no restart: get_status.instance_id is the same) and both boxes stay red; Every Cube on Model default takes the binding off (engine MT-2b; material_bindings null reads as Model default) and both are grey; the rows' Undo binds material_2 again and both are red; Every Cube back on material. This object on Cube_001: set_object_material material_2, and without a restart a red box beside a grey one (2 objects, 1 with their own). Use model default takes it away and the Inspector's Undo (the scene's) puts it back. Save, open another project and this one again: Cube_001 is still red, the Cube grey.
